# Ambispective Required-Only Input

Generate an ambispective clinical study document set: protocol DOCX, ICF DOCX, and ClinicalTrials.gov PRS XML.

Use the Advarra ICF template family.

## Study Overview


| Input                       | Value                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Full study title            | Ambispective Evaluation of the Sentinel Patch in Adults With Postoperative Pain                                                                            |
| Background and significance | Postoperative pain outcomes are captured inconsistently across historical records and prospective follow-up, limiting interpretation of recovery patterns. |
| Primary objectives          | Evaluate historical and prospective postoperative pain scores among adults using the Sentinel Patch monitoring workflow.                                   |
| Study hypothesis            | Combined historical records and prospective follow-up will show measurable improvement in pain tracking completeness by Month 3.                           |




## Study Methodology


| Input                                               | Value                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Study design                                        | Ambispective, multi-site, single-arm observational device study with historical chart review and prospective follow-up.                                                                           |
| Intervention name                                   | Sentinel Patch                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Intervention type                                   | Device                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Number of investigational sites                     | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Primary and secondary endpoints                     | Primary: change in pain tracking completeness from historical baseline to Month 3 prospective follow-up. Secondary: device adherence and participant usability score at Month 3.                  |
| Planned assessments and schedule                    | Historical chart abstraction, baseline prospective visit, Month 1 phone follow-up, and Month 3 clinic follow-up, including pain score review, device usage download, and usability questionnaire. |
| Minimum days before screening without another study | 30 days                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Sample size                                         | 60 participants                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Sample justification                                | The sample allows descriptive estimation across two sites while accounting for expected attrition and available historical records.                                                               |
| Sample-size evidence                                 | Planned sample: 60 participants (Approved synthetic source).                                                                                                                                       |
| Compensation or reimbursement                       | None                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Statistical analysis plan                           | Descriptive summaries for historical and prospective measures; paired summaries for participants with both baseline and Month 3 data.                                                             |
| Study timeline                                      | Historical record review plus prospective baseline through Month 3 follow-up, with prospective participation lasting approximately 14 weeks.                                                      |




## Population


| Input              | Value                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Inclusion criteria | Adults 18 to 80 years old with eligible historical records and ability to complete prospective Sentinel Patch follow-up.                                  |
| Exclusion criteria | Concurrent interventional study participation, incomplete historical records, inability to complete follow-up, or investigator-determined safety concern. |
